title: Vedha
desc: A father and daughter embark on a killing spree in a bid to seek revenge against those who have wronged them. However, a police officer seeks to put an end to their murders.

title: Moggina Manasu
desc: Renu, Akka, Didi and Chanchala are four friends from college who face several adversities in life. However, they find one way or another to live their life to the fullest.

title: Lakshmi Mahalakshmi
desc: Chandrappa believes that his daughter, Lakshmi, brings good luck and his second daughter, Anita, brings bad luck.

title: Hello
desc: A man finds and stores the contact number of his lost childhood love in his phone, which is then stolen by a mafia thug. He then sets out to retrieve the cellphone at all costs.

title: Thangigagi
desc: Veerabhadra, who loves his sister very much, gets her married to a nice man. However, when Veerabhadra's close friend is killed, he decides to wipe out anti-social elements in the city.
